VBO:0200268.summary: Affectionate and attentive to familiar people, the Cairnoodle is a Cairn Terrier–Poodle cross. Some enjoy curling up nearby and sharing a daily routine, while others are easygoing travel companions. A lively chasing streak can appear around rabbits, rodents or pheasants, and visitors can draw a territorial response.
VBO:0200268.shortDescription: Cairnoodles can combine close family attachment and cozy rest with lively outdoor chasing and adaptable travel companionship.
